tags.note: London comprises the City of London and 32 London boroughs. The City of London is officially a city, as is one of the boroughs: the City of Westminster.

tags.name: City of Westminster
tags.note: Westminster is a "city within a city"; this London borough has city status and forms part of the metropolitan area of London. The centre of London lies within the borough (at the statute of Charles I) and it is the centre of government in the UK.
tags.note_1: London comprises the City of London and 32 London boroughs. One of the boroughs - the City of Westminster - has city status. The status covers the entire borough.
